---
title: "Total eclipses by country"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(readr)
```
```{r}
#Get eclipse data
country_data <- read_csv("data/total_eclipses_by_country.csv")
```


```{r}
country_eclipse_counts <- country_data %>%
  count(country, name = "eclipse_count")
```


```{r}
plot_ly(
  country_eclipse_counts,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~country,
  locationmode = "country names",
  z = ~eclipse_count,
  text = ~paste(
    "Country:", country,
    "<br>Eclipses:", eclipse_count
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = list(
    c(0, 0.01, 1),
    c("white", "#E3DFFF", "#3D3A4B")
  ),
  zmin = 0,
  zmax = max(country_eclipse_counts$eclipse_count),
  marker = list(
    line = list(
      color = "white",
      width = 0.5
    )
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Solar Eclipse Density by Country",
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = TRUE,
      projection = list(
        type = "natural earth"
      )
    )
  )
```
